verdict.rationale: All evidence describes GitBook acting as an MCP *server* — publishing MCP endpoints so external AI agents can query GitBook's docs/content (gitbook-docs-14, gitbook-docs-15, gitbook-probe-rt-2, gitbook-probe-rt-3) — which is the opposite direction from the story: GitBook itself consuming/plugging in external MCP servers to use their tools. No evidence shows GitBook's AI Assistant or any internal agent connecting to third-party MCP servers as a client. Missing for 10: any documentation or hands-on evidence of GitBook configuring/connecting to external MCP servers, or its AI Assistant invoking tools from user-supplied MCP servers.
